title: English Practice Quiz 0867
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural of 'child'.
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I like tea, coffee and milk.
I like tea coffee and milk
I like, tea coffee, and milk.
i like tea, coffee and milk
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list and capitalise the first word.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.

questions.question: He speaks English ___.
questions.explanation: Clearly is the adverb describing how he speaks.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.
